name: Corpus Browse and Verify
ascii:
Legend: [D] = carried state/data; (O) = user-visible operation or source symbol.

CORPUS INTERACTION: BROWSE, REVEAL, VERIFY, RETURN

[D] DomainProfile  [domainProfile.ts: DomainProfile]
       |
       +--> [D] SOURCE_CODE_PROFILE  [domainProfiles.ts]
       |         Diagram Files / Diagram Sets; highlighted, unwrapped
       |
       +--> [D] DOCUMENT_PROFILE  [domainProfiles.ts]
                 Diagram Files / Sections / Highlights; plain, wrapped, TTY
       |
       | explorer tabs + ContentPresentation policy
       v
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                         WORKSPACE ENTRY POINTS                             |
|                                                                            |
| (O) diagramFileFilter  [fileTree.ts]                                       |
|     artifact Evidence IDs -> normalized, live local Corpus paths           |
|     excludes unresolved or foreign-provenance entities                     |
|          |                                                                 |
|          v                                                                 |
| (O) FileExplorerPanel  [FileExplorerPanel.tsx: loadDirectory/revealEntity] |
|     expandable checked-out repository hierarchy                            |
|          +-- explicit file selection ----------------------> [A] DIRECT    |
|          |                                                                 |
|          +-- associated Evidence row: entity ID + range ----> [B] MEDIATED |
|                                                                            |
| (O) TerminalMarkdownView outline callbacks  [TerminalMarkdownView.tsx]     |
|     parsed outline + active-section feedback                               |
|          |                                                                 |
|          v                                                                 |
| (O) MarkdownSectionsPanel  [MarkdownSectionsPanel.tsx]                     |
|     heading hierarchy; most-specific active/jump section                    |
|          +-- jumpToMarkdownSection(path, line, range) ------> [A] DIRECT   |
|          +-- mapJumpHistoryToSections: replay / clear controls             |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

                         PERSISTENT CORPUS ENTRY

[D] HighlightRecordV2  [highlights.ts]
     artifact revision + visual element + Evidence identity/source range
     optional document excerpt or tree lineage
       |
       v
(O) HighlightsTreePanel  [HighlightsTreePanel.tsx: buildTree]
       |
       v
(O) revealHighlight  [App.tsx]
     restore artifact -> recover Evidence ID/range -> [B] MEDIATED

Mapped visual claim
       |
       v
(O) revealCodeEntity  [App.tsx]
     Evidence entity ID + source-range index -> [B] MEDIATED

[B] EVIDENCE INTERMEDIARY
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] EvidenceEntity  [domainProfile.ts]                                     |
|     identity / handle / label / kind / summary                             |
|     stable SourceRange anchors into the authoritative Corpus               |
|          |                                                                 |
|          v                                                                 |
| (O) CodeEntitiesPanel  [CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx]                             |
|     select associated Evidence and its exact range                         |
|          |                                                                 |
|          v                                                                 |
| (O) fetchSourceSnippet  [CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx]                            |
|     local active range; captured original lines for foreign Evidence       |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       +-------------------------------------------------------> [A]

[A] SOURCE PRESENTATION - governed by ContentPresentation
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| (O) renderer dispatch  [CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx]                             |
|       |                                                                    |
|       +--> (O) SourceCodeView  [SourceCodeView.tsx]                        |
|       |        syntax or plain; selected-range scroll; wrapping policy     |
|       |        optional compaction with independently expandable context   |
|       |                                                                    |
|       +--> (O) TerminalMarkdownView  [TerminalMarkdownView.tsx]            |
|                sandboxed Markdown; target line/range scroll + highlight    |
|                repository links; outline and active-section reports        |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
                  USER READS AND VERIFIES CORPUS
                                |
                                v
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| (O) PaneNavigationApi  [navigation.ts]                                     |
|     activate destination tab/pane; de-duplicate recent destinations        |
|     registerHandler -> scheduled destination-specific scroll/focus         |
|     jump -> replay; clearHistory -> remove recorded jumps                   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       ^
       +------ reversible return to a prior claim, section, or Corpus view
